title: Light creates a temporary chemical stencil
caption: The resist pattern protects selected regions during a later operation. Which regions remain depends on the resist system.

nodes.label: Coat
nodes.detail: Apply photoresist to the prepared surface.

nodes.label: Expose
nodes.detail: Projected light changes local resist chemistry.

nodes.label: Develop
nodes.detail: Remove the selected resist regions.

nodes.label: Transfer
nodes.detail: Use the openings to modify the underlying layer.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Resolution depends on more than wavelength
caption: Wavelength, collection angle and process behavior jointly affect what can be printed. A node name is not a direct measure of any one of these.

nodes.label: Wavelength
nodes.detail: The light’s spatial oscillation scale matters.

nodes.label: Numerical aperture
nodes.detail: The optics collect and focus a range of angles.

nodes.label: Process
nodes.detail: Mask design and resist behavior shape the result.

nodes.label: Printed feature
nodes.detail: The developed structure is the combined outcome.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Immersion changes the last optical gap
caption: An immersion system uses water between the final optical element and wafer to support a larger numerical aperture. The projected pattern still acts through resist chemistry.

nodes.label: DUV illumination
nodes.detail: A laser supplies the lithography wavelength.

nodes.label: Projection optics
nodes.detail: Form the image from the mask pattern.

nodes.label: Immersion gap
nodes.detail: Water changes the optical conditions near the wafer.

nodes.label: Resist surface
nodes.detail: Receives the image and is developed afterward.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: EUV travels through a reflective optical chain
caption: Tin plasma emits usable EUV. Reflective optics transport and pattern it in vacuum because ordinary transparent optics and air absorb too much.

nodes.label: Tin plasma
nodes.detail: Laser energy drives emission from the prepared tin target.

nodes.label: Collector
nodes.detail: Captures part of the useful emitted light.

nodes.label: Reflective mask
nodes.detail: Encodes the circuit pattern by reflection.

nodes.label: Projection mirrors
nodes.detail: Deliver the image to the resist-coated wafer.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Individual events become a developed edge
caption: Photon arrival and absorption are statistical. Resist chemistry must turn these discrete events into a sufficiently reliable shape.

nodes.label: Incident photons
nodes.detail: Energy arrives in individual quanta.

nodes.label: Absorbed events
nodes.detail: Only a fraction of arriving photons initiate useful activity.

nodes.label: Chemical response
nodes.detail: Local reactions change solubility.

nodes.label: Developed pattern
nodes.detail: Randomness can contribute to roughness or missing features.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.

title: Measure, correct and print in registration
caption: A correctly sized contact is useful only if it lands on its intended connection. Alignment and height measurements support corrective settings.

nodes.label: Measure marks
nodes.detail: Locate existing structures on the wafer.

nodes.label: Correct position
nodes.detail: Account for measured placement and distortion.

nodes.label: Expose layer
nodes.detail: Print the next pattern in the corrected frame.

nodes.label: Check overlay
nodes.detail: Assess how the new and previous layers align.

note: Conceptual schematic; geometry is not to scale.
